name: 46202 · Indianapolis, IN
findings: ZIP 46202 (Indianapolis) has 369 nonprofit organizations. 190 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 162 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46202 (Indianapolis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46202 (Indianapolis) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
